headline.statement: Every probe targeting an existing signal now names, in the node's exact words, which statement it means. Two signals probed in the same life context produce distinct questions, closing F-015 at the same seam.
headline.criterion_met: Can I always tell which of my own statements SELF is talking about? Yes — asserted as F008-08 over generated probes, and read end to end in a scripted run.

the_separation.law: QUOTE = what the node actually said. REVELATION = what SELF is authorized to say the evidence implies. PROBE = what SELF asks next.
the_separation.why_it_matters: Blurring them yields 'You said you always take control...' when the node said 'I ended up running the meeting' — manufacturing the very correction E3 would later congratulate itself for detecting.
the_separation.how_it_is_enforced: The quote is interpolated verbatim and never paraphrased, so that sentence is not constructible. The revelation remains a separate transcript turn emitted only through check_revelation(), which renders life_context_count rather than context_count.

boundaries.1_verbatim_only: Quote is the byte-exact verbatim of the episode it names. No truncation, no ellipsis, no case or punctuation repair. Specimen F008-02.
boundaries.2_provenance_belongs_to_target: The anchor is drawn from graph.supports(signal_id), so borrowing a memorable sentence from another signal is not expressible. Specimen F008-01.
boundaries.3_confers_zero_standing: Generating probes and rendering references leaves the graph deep-equal and every standing identical. Specimen F008-04.
boundaries.4_graceful_degradation: With no quotable statement, SELF emits a PROPOSITION_REFERENCE explicitly labelled 'not as a quote', and invents nothing. Specimen F008-05.

findings.severity: DEFECT, REPAIRED — found BY the anchor
findings.title: SELF named a life domain the evidence did not support
findings.observed: _home_context fell back to OPENABLE_CONTEXTS[0] when a signal had no placed domain. In the first anchored run SELF quoted a statement made about 'something you make' and then asked for an occasion 'in your work'.
findings.why_it_was_invisible: While probes had no referent, the question said 'that happened' with nothing to compare the domain against. Putting the node's own sentence beside the domain name made the contradiction legible in a single reading.
findings.repair: Naming a domain the evidence does not support is the same defect as inventing a quote, so it is refused the same way: _home_context returns None rather than guessing, and the domain clause is omitted.
findings.significance: The anchor did diagnostic work immediately. This is evidence that F-008 was structural rather than cosmetic.

findings.severity: OBSERVATION — by construction, not a defect
findings.title: A correction offered as an answer is quoted back as the signal's anchor
findings.statement: If a node answers a probe with a correction rather than an answer, the runtime records it as the answer and will quote it back as the tracked pattern.
findings.why_it_is_not_repaired: Distinguishing a correction from an answer is inference, and this runtime has no inference layer — that absence is the property making its corpus worth measuring. Detecting corrections is precisely what E3 does LATER, in shadow, after the transcript is frozen.
findings.consequence: Real sessions will contain these cases, and that is desirable: they are exactly the material an on-distribution corpus needs and the events E3D-001/002 describe.
findings.for_the_node: Worth knowing before first contact that SELF will echo a correction as though it were a pattern. It cannot yet tell the difference, and saying so is more honest than hiding it.
